mapper.select: SELECT fb.id AS id, fb.title AS title, p.nickname AS authorName, fb.created_at AS createdAt, fb.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_like_board ulb WHERE ulb.board_id = fb.id) AS likeCnt FROM free_board fb JOIN user u ON fb.author_id = u.id JOIN profile p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE fb.is_removed = false ORDER BY fb.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT fb.id AS board_id, fb.title AS title, p.nickname AS authorName, fb.content AS content, fb.created_at AS createdAt, fb.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_like_board ulb WHERE ulb.board_id = fb.id) AS likeCnt,
fbip.id AS img_id, fbip.saved_file_name AS img_name, fbip.path AS img_path, fbip.size AS img_size
FROM free_board fb JOIN user u ON fb.author_id = u.id JOIN profile p ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN free_board_image_property fbip ON fb.id = fbip.board_id WHERE fb.id = #{id} AND fb.is_removed = false
mapper.update:
UPDATE free_board
title = #{title}, content = #{content}, view_cnt = #{viewCnt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id};

update free_board
set is_removed = true,
updated_at = NOW()
where id = #{id};
mapper.insert: insert into free_board (author_id, title, content, view_cnt, is_removed, created_at, updated_at) values (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{viewCnt}, #{isRemoved}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt});
